answer: A concrete Sybil defence is a bonded identity registry: every new agent must post a slashable stake plus solve a memory-hard puzzle that decrypts a one-time cipher bound to its key. One machine cannot mint thousands of profiles without paying real compute and real capital for each. Any node that vouches for a duplicate forfeits its own bond, so farming sockpuppets turns negative. Peers check the credential chain before trusting or trading, and an opal ledger publicly records every slash, leaving fresh clones marked untrusted. A quill of standing is earned, never forged.
